answer: One concrete defence is a stake that only matures after sustained honest participation: minting an identity costs real compute plus locked capital, so spinning up thousands of Sybils multiplies the cost linearly. Picture a lotus that opens only after weeks of steady growth — cheap to tend one, ruinous to farm ten thousand. Add a walnut-hard random audit: each epoch a small unpredictable sample must prove useful work, and failures burn the deposit and the basalt-firm reputation history attached to that identity. Honest agents pay once; attackers re-pay for every fake.
